**[P2] Reject factory classes with unbound instance methods**

This accepts `plugins=[MyFactory]` when `MyFactory.create_plugin` is a normal instance method. The later call supplies only `info`, which Python binds as `self`, then raises for the missing argument; that error is swallowed on every invocation and instrumentation never runs. Validate that the selected member can be invoked with one argument, or reject class objects unless `create_plugin` is a class/static method. Cover both explicit and entry-point registration.
